title: Saved rebinds for gamepad aim / pause were lost; removed pad defaults came back
body: Gamepad defaults were installed after the saved controls.cfg was applied, so saved binds for aim / pause were overwritten and pad defaults the player removed returned on next launch.

title: Objective modes counted kills in the team score (CTF won on the first capture)
body: In CTF / INF / HTF / DOM / PM kills were added to the same score as captures, so a CTF team with two kills won on its first capture (limit 3). Kills now only score in DM / TDM / Rambo / BR / GG.

title: Touch buttons covered the HP / JET readouts and the kill feed
body: Default touch button stacks started at the top of the screen over the HUD. They now start below it; saved custom positions are kept.

title: Multiplayer desync with 2+ players: replicas auto-renamed after a duplicate spawn
body: When a body was spawned twice on a peer (join mirror + broadcast, or respawn in the same frame) the new node was auto-renamed (@CharacterBody2D@N) while the old one was still in the tree, so every later state / shot RPC for that player failed on that peer and the other player appeared frozen.

title: Single player spammed 'No multiplayer peer is assigned' (~50 errors/s)
body: Leaving multiplayer or starting from the menu set the multiplayer peer to null, so every authority check logged an error. SP now runs on OfflineMultiplayerPeer.

title: Realistic mode: bullets hitting bots threw a script error and did no damage
body: The headshot check read a `prone` field bots don't have (bool(null)), so every bullet that hit a bot errored and bots took no bullet damage in Realistic.

title: GIF recorder logged an engine error every frame on headless / dedicated
body: The recorder read the viewport texture on a headless instance. It is now a no-op there.

title: Hosting after an editor play-test loaded the play-test map
body: Settings.custom_map_path kept pointing at user://maps/_playtest.json after a play-test, so Host Game (and a dedicated server started with --map) loaded that map instead of the one picked.

title: Host broadcasts reached peers still loading the match ('Node not found: Main')
body: Spawns, despawns, kill feed, objective events, Gun Game rungs, votes and round resets used plain rpc(), which also reaches a peer that is still loading. They now go through main.bcast() to peers whose Main exists.

title: Limbo weapon menu never appeared; every respawn reset you to the AK-74
body: The weapon panel only showed for a dead-but-valid player, but the body is freed on death, so it never showed. Respawns always used the default loadout. The menu now shows while dead, picks the primary / secondary you respawn with (saved), and works with keys, mouse and touch (1609ce0).

title: In-flight packets to a dead / disconnected player's freed node logged errors on every peer
body: The body was freed immediately on death / disconnect, so state and shot packets already in flight hit a missing node. It now lingers 1.5 s as an inert husk (disconnects too: 156cd4d).

title: Single-player map picker showed 'Rotation' while PLAY loaded the play-test map
body: A custom map path that isn't in the picker list (the editor's _playtest slot or a deleted file) is now cleared when the menu builds the list.

title: Release gate results depended on the machine's saved settings
body: Tests toggled mods / bot counts / loadouts and some saved them, so later gate runs measured different games (CTF sweep kills doubled). Every Godot launch in the gate now starts from default settings and the machine's files are restored afterwards.

title: Bot LAW shots missing on clients ('Node not found: Main/BotRocket_...')
body: A replica's loadout / secondary flag syncs unreliably at state rate; when it lagged the host, the client fired a bullet where the host fired a rocket, and the host's rocket RPCs hit a node the client never created. The weapon now travels with the shot RPC.

title: Limbo weapon menu taps were eaten by the touch overlay
body: The touch overlay handled every touch as joystick / aim input. Controls in the `touch_passthrough` group now receive taps; rows are taller on touch screens and the panel sits beside the left button column.

title: Spectator target couldn't be switched on touch or gamepad
body: Only the keyboard arrows cycled the follow target. Tapping the left / right half of the screen and LB / RB / D-pad now switch it; the hint text matches the device.

title: Objective edge arrows landed on the timer / score strip
body: Arrows are now clamped below the top HUD row.

title: Domination: bots walked off a point before the 4 s capture finished
body: Standing on the goal looked like being stuck to the anti-stuck logic, which kicked in after ~2 s. Also: bots now hold altitude stepping onto a ledge after a climb (Equinox's blue spawn shaft trapped them) and Kampf's third DOM point moved off an unreachable ledge. All-map DOM sweep: 204 -> 330 captures, falls 10 -> 2.

title: Bots jetted into the underside of ledges on tall slanted climbs (MFM)
body: Bots steered straight for the top node and cut the corner into the ledge. They now follow the nav link's line.

title: Bonus grants and client-owned grenades / rockets broadcast to peers still loading
body: apply_bonus / net_bonus_clear and client projectiles used rpc() (relayed to everyone). They now go only to loaded peers; the host pushes the ready list to clients. Ten per-mode two-client soaks: zero errors.

title: Listen host had no bots; Host Game couldn't host custom maps
body: Only dedicated servers spawned bots, so friends on a listen server played alone. The host now uses the Bots setting like single player, and the Host Game picker lists your own maps (sent to clients as JSON).

title: Objective banners printed over the spectator lines while dead
body: While dead the banner now shows below the death text.

title: Death screen said 'killed by <you>' for suicides
body: Now 'You died'. The empty vitals box also hides while dead.

title: Map editor toolbar overflowed its backing strip
body: The toolbar wraps to three rows at 1280 px; the strip now sizes to it. The toolbar also uses the game's UI style and highlights the active tool.

title: LAN game discovery (Find Games lists local hosts)
body: Hosts broadcast a small beacon on UDP 23074; Join -> Find Games lists LAN games live. Different builds show greyed out. Gate stage C checks it.

title: Map editor undo / redo
body: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y (or Ctrl+Shift+Z) and toolbar buttons, 60 snapshot steps. Touch: two-finger pan / pinch zoom (03eb4e0); Android back (41405be).

title: Controls help card (first matches, H toggles)
body: Bottom-centre card built from the live bindings (pad buttons when a controller is connected).

title: Host Game: mode picker, LAN note, master-server listing for listen hosts
body: Mode picker beside the map (817f896), LAN join note / IP, 'List on the master server' registers a listen host like a dedicated one. Join remembers the last address (ca43342).

title: Low-FPS guard switches Lo-fi on once
body: Under ~35 fps for 8 s after a warm-up, Lo-fi turns on with a chat notice.

title: Kill confirmation line and pause-menu session info
body: 'KILLED <name>' (with headshot) under the action; pause menu shows map, mode and the connection / hosting address (eb838e2).
